records.words: Test finished doors in quiet time? That was literally my complaint last time. Those boxes are for a new hill though, so I resume and hope.
Big screen this time, the hill is huge. Same start. Chalk, dig right of the cellar.
Door in the shaft again, that worked last time.
Door marked first try again. Last time the door took till 22 Aug, I am not waiting at Steady for that. Fast.

Way faster this time. Fast speed and the door was carved and Meryem rolled it within a day of game time, half a real minute. I want to shut that door myself now, without a false alarm. The start page promised testing finished doors in quiet time but only for a new hill, so I do not know if my resumed hill has it. Big desktop hill is nice, I can actually see the shaft. Still no idea when riders come.
Can I shut it myself now?
Same bell answer as last time. So my resumed hill does not have the quiet door test. Checking More anyway.
Fine. Last time I refused the false alarm and left. This time I ring it and see who shuts my door, Yusuf, Meryem, Maryam or Tamar. Trust be damned, it is an experiment.

"They looked at the bell, then at you." Ha, ouch, I deserved that. But on Fast the whole six hours flew past in ten seconds and I never saw anybody shut the door. Did someone? I missed my own experiment.

Nothing in the Journal about the door being shut. I spent their trust on the false alarm and got a dirty look and no answer to the one thing I wanted. I could ring it again on Slow, but now it costs more trust and I am not sure anyone will do it. I would leave here.

Stopping after the false alarm. The quit wish did not pass. Fast got me the door quickly, which was nice, but then the bell call blew past on Fast and I never saw anyone shut my door, just them looking at me. I would close it, not leave it running. I would not return voluntarily tonight. Maybe another evening on a new hill if the quiet door test the start page mentions lets me just try the door. Feedback: I'm stopping pressed locally; nothing typed or submitted, consent unchanged.
